correctness.rationale: With B=dcl(A) meet-closed, quantifier elimination identifies complete 1-types with one-point-generated finite meet-tree extensions over B. Estevan–Kaplan Remark 4.6 permits at most one additional meet. A complete rooted-tree case split gives s realized, 2s extensions with no extra meet, and s extensions with one extra meet. The closure-size extremum follows from a tree child-count. Exhaustive finite replay checks every labeled base through s=4.
